emails.subject: DSPy agents burning budget? We built guardrails
emails.hook: Saw your work on DSPy — the programmatic approach to LLM optimization is exactly right.
emails.story: But we noticed DSPy agents can rack up costs fast when the optimizer loops. Last week one of our test agents spent $2,800 in 60 seconds during a compile step. So we built AgentShield — a per-transaction firewall that sits between your agent and the API, blocking any call that violates spend rules. Pure Python stdlib, zero dependencies, sub-millisecond evaluation.
emails.offer: Here's the architecture if you're curious: https://dev.to/maryan_k_bef6cf83fa64e809/i-built-a-firewall-for-ai-agent-spending-here-is-the-architecture-2560
